name: Extension read-back probe
tagline: A NIGHTLY read-back probe: a titlebar status item and a composer mention from the customize app.
description: Installed into a fresh home by cmux-ci fresh-home --nightly to read back cmux.status/1 (cmux#47317) and cmux.composer.mention/1 (cmux#49239) on a published NIGHTLY. Remove it and everything you had comes back.
